segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 部署、监控与回滚 with a teammate. I use deployment to talk about 部署，把应用发布到可运行环境的过程. I use monitoring to talk about 监控，持续观察系统状态和关键指标. I use health check to talk about 健康检查，自动判断服务是否正常运行. I tell my teammate: Today I use deployment, monitoring, and health check. At the end, I say: I can use deployment clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 部署、监控与回滚 with a teammate. I use rollback to talk about 回滚，把系统恢复到之前稳定版本. I use production environment to talk about 生产环境，真实用户使用的正式运行环境. I use service outage to talk about 服务中断，用户暂时无法使用服务的情况. I tell my teammate: Today I use rollback, production environment, and service outage. At the end, I say: I can use rollback clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 项目介绍 with a teammate. I use Today I'd like to present ... to talk about 今天我想介绍……. I use The goal of this project is ... to talk about 这个项目的目标是……. I use Here is the main result. to talk about 这是主要结果。. I tell my teammate: Today I use Today I'd like to present ..., The goal of this project is ..., and Here is the main result.. At the end, I say: I can use Today I'd like to present ... clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 发布工作流 with a teammate. I use release branch to talk about 发布分支，为准备新版本建立的分支. I use deployment approval to talk about 部署批准，发布生产环境前的人工确认. I use production deploy to talk about 生产部署，把版本发布给真实用户. I tell my teammate: Today I use release branch, deployment approval, and production deploy. At the end, I say: I can use release branch clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 发布工作流 with a teammate. I use rollback plan to talk about 回滚计划，发布失败时恢复旧版本的方案. I tell my teammate: Today I use rollback plan, release checklist, and post-release check. At the end, I say: I can use rollback plan clearly today.
